title: Establishment of a bio- and DNA bank with register in patients with cystic fibrosis.
summary: In patients with cystic fibrosis, the course of the lung disease and the colonisation of the lungs with bacteria (e.g. Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa) as well as the inflammatory reaction in the lungs varies greatly from individual to individual. This indicates that in addition to the actual basic defect causing the disease, the changes in the CFTR gene, other factors can also influence the lung disease in cystic fibrosis. On the one hand, these can be environmental factors such as bacteria, and on the other hand, there seem to be other disease-modifying genes that influence the course of the disease. With the help of this study, data and samples from patients with cystic fibrosis will be obtained to investigate this further.

interventions.name: Collecting clinical data and samples from patients with cystic fibrosis in a registry and a DNA- and biobank.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed diagnosis of cystic fibrosis
Exclusion criteria:
All persons who or whose parents refuse to participate or exercise their right to withdraw, or who are uncertain about the diagnosis of cystic fibrosis, will be excluded.
